# 2019 Elections

There was 1 election held in Jersey in 2019.

- **[St Helier No 3 & 4 Deputy By-Election](https://flow.je/elections/2019#e45)**

  1 seat · 10 candidates · 18.7% turnout

Visit **[Vote.je](https://www.vote.je/)** for official information on the elections.

[**View a sentiment analysis of the manifestos**](https://flow.je/elections/2019/analysis)

* * *

* * *

## 2019 St Helier No 3 & 4 Deputy By-Election

By-Election following the death of [Richard Rondel](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/richard-rondel) (1 seat), 27th February 2019.

**[Inna Gardiner](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/inna-gardiner) was elected as Deputy of St Helier No 3 & 4 in 2019**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Inna Gardiner](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/inna-gardiner)** |  | 391 | 24.4% |
| 2 | [Lyndsay Feltham](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/lyndsay-feltham) | [Reform Jersey](https://flow.je/elections/parties/reform-jersey) | 324 | 20.3% |
| 3 | [Anthony Lewis](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/anthony-lewis) |  | 245 | 15.3% |
| 4 | [Nick Le Cornu](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/nick-le-cornu) |  | 143 | 8.9% |
| 5 | [John Baker](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/john-baker) |  | 142 | 8.9% |
| 6 | [Andrea Talibard-Mallet](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/andrea-talibard-mallet) |  | 120 | 7.5% |
| 7 | [Guy de Faye](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/guy-de-faye) |  | 76 | 4.8% |
| 8 | [Francesca Ahier](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/francesca-ahier) |  | 60 | 3.8% |
| 9 | [Geraint Jennings](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/geraint-jennings) |  | 59 | 3.7% |
| 10 | [Gordon Troy](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/gordon-troy) |  | 34 | 2.1% |

1,600 votes (inc. 6 spoilt papers)

8,579 registered voters

18.7% turnout
